items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps the routine simple and kind to skin that looks low in moisture.
A lower-strength retinol is a comfortable starting point for smoother-looking texture and fine lines when you are new to retinoids.
A ceramide moisturizer supports a more comfortable, hydrated look and helps cushion skin while it adjusts to retinol.
Daily mineral SPF 50 is essential alongside retinol, which makes skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol serum at night just 2 evenings a week, then build up slowly as skin stays comfortable, and apply sunscreen every morning. We started with the 0.3% retinol instead of the 1% serum plus retinal eye cream because layering two strong retinoids from day one is much more likely to cause irritation, and you can add one later once your skin is settled.
